metadata.case_name: YU HIU KIT KATHY v. LSG LUFTHANSA SERVICE HONG KONG LIMITED

plaintiff.occupation_before: kitchen worker in the defendant’s Production Department

injuries.description: back contusion injury with tenderness over the right side of her body
source: When the plaintiff was taken to PMH on 16 March 2009, she was found to have sustained a back contusion injury with tenderness over the right side of her body.
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of lower back or pelvis

source: On 25 March 2010, PMH conducted another video urodynamic study on the plaintiff which showed atonic bladder and acontractile bladder.
She was diagnosed as suffering from Depression.

manifestations.description: tenderness over the right side of her body
incomplete emptying / poor initiation of self-void
required self-intermittent catheterization (SIC) (up to eight times a day)
depressed mood, loss of energy and interest in activities, fatigue and impairment of sleep and concentration
nightmares and flashbacks of the Incident
occasional falls with sudden weakness of the legs

treatments_received: admission to Orthopaedics Department of Princess Margaret Hospital
Work Capacity Evaluation and work rehabilitation

losses.description: Plaintiff pleaded that she "stays at home and does not like going out."

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Plaintiff pleaded that she "lost interests in her hobbies" (e.g. ceased aerobic dancing and swimming; later resumed some activities).

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Plaintiff pleaded she suffered "inconvenience in her daily activities" affecting daily life activities such as cooking and shopping.
Plaintiff pleaded that her sex life had been adversely affected and her relationship with her boyfriend deteriorated; boyfriend left her in about February 2012.
